checks.name: Start captures the actual browser pointer lock
Mouse right turns right, with stable per-pixel sensitivity
Rendered yaw follows input without an angular spring; orbit remains 11.6 units
Forward flight follows the same rightward mouse heading
Mouse up looks up on a real vertical axis
Vertical look clamps safely without flipping or changing orbit radius
Escape releases the cursor, pauses once, and paused mouse motion is ignored
Pause exposes keyboard-accessible sensitivity and vertical inversion controls
Repeated Resume and Escape cycles recapture and release cleanly
Sensitivity and inversion persist across a reload
Lower sensitivity changes angular travel and inverted up motion looks down
Sandbox denial is recoverable and advertises drag fallback
Fallback dragging preserves conventional horizontal and vertical directions
Releasing a fallback drag stops rotation
Pointer cancellation clears fallback drag state
Lost pointer capture clears fallback drag state
No uncaught JavaScript or unexpected console errors
